blind.B1: No for an exercise question. The 8 sequenced SOL samples (4 flox, 4 MI4KO) differ only by genotype; no sequenced animal was exercised (S4.17.p1, S2.5.p1). Exercise findings are qPCR/western (S2.1.p1).
blind.B2: SOL: MI4KO vs flox, n=4 vs 4 (S4.17.p1, S2.5.p1); normalized to flox; 447 DEGs.
blind.B3: None within this series (one muscle per mouse, independent mice). Packet A lists no candidate pairing key. Same mouse IDs may recur in GSE136623 but across separate series and different muscles.
blind.B4: Paper does not say joint or pairwise; two groups only, so moot. edgeR with TMM (S4.17.p1).
blind.B5: 'fold change of at least 1.5 and a p-value of <0.05' (S4.17.p1); '|fold-change| of >=1.5 and a p-value of <0.05' (S2.5.p1). Raw p, not FDR. Count: 447 in SOL.
